scope: Read-only independent source review of shared chapter-topic navigation against baselinec85a178, focused tests and reproducible helper behavior. No source files changed.

findings.title: Scope latest results by topic key or subject as well as title
findings.body: The new shared UI exposes topics from every subject, but latestTopicResult finds the first title match. MBL-2 chapter3 has Bleeding Disorders under Physiology and Pathology; a Physiology-only result is displayed on both cards. MCNS-2 chapter11 and MSS-2 chapter9 also have multiple Past Exams titles. Runtime reproduction with distinct saved topic keys returned the Physiology100% score for Pathology. Match full topic key, with subject-aware fallback for legacy history.
findings.reproduction: Two subjects with lectureNames=[Bleeding Disorders], questions p/x, history containing only topicResults Physiologys distinct key: both title calls returned Physiology result.
findings.test_gap: New tests use one subject and unique titles.

findings.title: Preserve lookup of legacy saved single-topic sessions
findings.body: Every direct topic click now constructs a custom sessionKey. handleSelectSubject only loads that key, while baseline topic cards passed the original subject with no sessionKey and saved under subject.name. Existing GIT/MINF/MSS lecture attempts with the identical question set saved under e.g. Oral cavity are bypassed and users start anew instead of seeing Resume. Preserve an exact-question/version-checked legacy lookup or migrate the saved topic key/drafts. Do not resume a broad subject attempt into a smaller topic.
findings.evidence: Read baseline c85a178 SubjectSelect.tsx onClick passed subject directly; current QuizInterface persists sessionKey??name and useQuizSession getKey embeds that string.
findings.test_gap: Tests verify newly created custom subset resumption, not previously saved named-topic attempts.

findings.title: Keep original single-topic subject metadata on resume
findings.body: ChapterTopicList replaces run.subject.id/iconName with the source subject when first starting, but resumeCustomPractice reconstructs selectedPractice without that replacement. A Pathology-only topic in a physiology-accent chapter resumes with subject.id physiology and ListChecks icon; ResultsDashboard uses subject.id for styling. Question practiceTopic subjectName remains Pathology, so question-level learning attribution is preserved, but session subject metadata differs across start/resume. Derive source metadata for single-topic selections in selectedPractice or restore it in resumeCustomPractice.
findings.reproduction: Two-subject synthetic chapter accent physiology; selected Pathology question x; reconstructed subject.id was physiology despite practiceTopic.subjectName Pathology.

verified_behaviors: Direct topic cards use only selected topic IDs and attach original practiceTopic metadata without mutating source bank.
Empty topics disabled and counts reflect topic questions rather than subject total.
Shuffle remains delegated to existing prepareQuestions; custom resume reconstructs saved ID order.
Learning progress remains scoped by module and selected question IDs, including case children rolled to parent.
Cloud/history storage and same-tab asu-history-updated subscription remain active.
SoundToggle has accessible action name, hidden SVG, described help, keyboard-native button, 44px size and visible focus.
No colour-guide strings remain in reviewed chapter/topic navigation.
CSS provides one-column mobile layout, native button focus states and reduced-motion treatment.
limitations: No browser visual rendering performed; CSS and component accessibility reviewed statically and in jsdom tests.
No full all-module user-flow simulation or live cloud/account interaction performed.
No code mutations or production changes.
outcome: Changes need the two P2 resume/history fixes; source-level topic count/selection/shuffle and sound-control checks pass.
